trusted_assumptions: vstd contract for str::as_bytes: the returned byte slice equals the UTF-8 encoding of the string view
derived lower-level contract for <[u8]>::trim_ascii: the returned slice is the boundary-trimmed byte subrange described by byte_trim_bounds
vstd contract for core::str::from_utf8_unchecked: valid UTF-8 input bytes are preserved as the result string bytes
rationale: The ordinary const exec function mechanically desugars the exact as_bytes().trim_ascii()/from_utf8_unchecked body. Verified lemmas connect ASCII byte boundaries to UTF-8 character boundaries and prove that the supplied fold equals the resulting character subrange.
